{"metadata":{"description":"为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 3D 智能体工作轨迹可视化插件。A 3D agent-work trajectory visualization plugin for DeepSeek Harness.","id":"gh:1337304515","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-agent-astra","slug":"Rgndmln/dsh-agent-astra","topics":["agent-visualization","ai-agent","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins","threejs","typescript"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 3D 智能体工作轨迹可视化插件。A 3D agent-work trajectory visualization plugin for DeepSeek "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ek Harness 打造的 3D 智能体工作轨迹可视化插件。A 3D agent-work trajectory visualization plugin for DeepSeek Harness."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# AgentAstra"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> A spatial conversation view for DeepSeek Harness. Watch an agent move through time, touch tools an"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"d files, and leave a readable trail behind."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"`AgentAstra` is the product name. `spatial-trajectory` remains the package and Harness identifier."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Most agent UIs turn a busy run into a long list of messages and collapsed tool rows. This plugin tak"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"es a different route: it keeps the conversation itself, but lays the work out as a small space you c"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"an move through. A reply, a command, a file edit, and a delegated task are no longer just rows in a "},{"id":"p5s4","text":"transcript—they have a place, a relationship, and a moment in time."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## What you can see at a glance"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Semantic time (Z)** — move through meaningful events rather than every streaming token. The past"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" fades, the present is marked, and future structure stays deliberately opaque.
- **Causal lanes (X)*"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"* — input, control, and outcome are separated so it is easier to spot what caused a tool call and wh"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"at it produced.
- **Information layers (Y)** — execution, dialogue, and artifacts occupy different h"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"eights instead of competing in one flat feed.
- **An active workbench** — when the agent is reading,"},{"id":"p7s6","text":" writing, or invoking a tool, the agent and its real targets move into a shared work area and are co"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"nnected by a small animated tether.
- **The conversation is still there** — user messages and final "},{"id":"p7s8","text":"agent replies are projected as readable cards. Select one to open its full Markdown content; nothing"},{"id":"p7s9","text":" important is replaced with a decorative visualization."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The GIF above was recorded from a fresh, read-only Flash-model session. It follows two short prompts"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" through their semantic checkpoints, including a single `pwd` tool call. No repository files were re"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"ad or changed for the recording."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Install as a DeepSeek Harness plugin"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"This is a **DeepSeek Harness plugin**. It targets `@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.0-rc.6` and uses the Harness"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" client module loader."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Install it into the `web` profile from GitHub with either form:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Then open a conversation in DeepSeek Harness and choose **Spatial**. The view is session-scoped: it "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"renders the currently selected conversation only, and disposes its WebGL scene when the view unmount"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"nders the currently selected conversation only, and disposes its WebGL scene when the view unmounts."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"If macOS reaches its file-watcher limit during local Harness development, `CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=1 dsh"},{"id":"p14s2","text":" web` is a practical temporary workaround."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Moving through a run"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| Action | Result |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| `↑` / `↓` | Previous / next semantic event |
| `Shift + ↑` / `Shift + ↓` | Previous / next visible"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" user or agent message |
| Pause, drag the rail, or use `Home` / `End` | Inspect history without res"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"etting your orbit or zoom |
| Click a node | Select it and open its floating detail card |
| Double-"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"click a node | Deliberately focus the camera on it |
| Drag an exact file snapshot | Put its real co"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"ntent into the native composer draft |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The detail card can be dragged when it overlaps the composer. File paths are compacted in the scene;"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" the complete path and Markdown preview remain available in the card."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## What becomes a node"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The projection is intentionally selective. It keeps things a person would recognize as part of the w"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"projection is intentionally selective. It keeps things a person would recognize as part of the work:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- the start and end of an agent run;
- human prompts and the assistant's visible reply text;
- tools"},{"id":"p21s2","text":", delegated agents, files, and external resources;
- explicit read, write, call, delegate, and flow "},{"id":"p21s3","text":"relationships;
- an aggregated activity record for streaming replies, so a long answer does not beco"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"me thousands of tiny nodes."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Internal reasoning, tool arguments, usage records, injected context, and raw streaming fragments do "},{"id":"p22s2","text":"**not** become conversation bubbles. The visual view should add orientation, not expose implementati"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"come conversation bubbles. The visual view should add orientation, not expose implementation debris."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## How it is put together"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"`src/projection.ts` is the source of truth for semantic meaning. `src/App.tsx` turns the selected ti"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"me into a bounded, readable window. `src/spatial-renderer.ts` is concerned only with rendering and i"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"nteraction. That separation keeps the replay logic testable without WebGL and prevents UI details fr"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"om changing event facts."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Deliberate boundaries"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"- The browser view never writes workspace files on its own.
- A historical file can be pushed to the"},{"id":"p27s2","text":" composer only when the Harness event has an exact source snapshot. Metadata-only history stays unav"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"ailable rather than inventing an attachment.
- The view follows the active session. Background conve"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"rsations are not left rendering after you switch away.
- Canvas textures and animated links are boun"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"ded; dense tool bursts collapse into a quiet execution trace instead of a cloud of repeated geometry"},{"id":"p27s6","text":".
- If WebGL is unavailable, the surrounding controls and textual fallback remain usable."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Repository map"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"MIT."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## Status"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"This is an experimental interaction plugin, not an attempt to turn every agent run into a videogame."},{"id":"p33s2","text":" The goal is simpler: when an agent is busy, you should be able to glance at the space and understan"},{"id":"p33s3","text":"d what it is doing, what it is touching, and where the answer came from."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"# AgentAstra"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"> 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的空间化对话视图。让智能体在时间中移动、触碰工具和文件，并留下可以阅读的工作轨迹。"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"`AgentAstra` 是产品名称；`spatial-trajectory` 仍是技术包和 Harness 标识符。"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"多数 Agent 界面会把一次忙碌的运行压成很长的消息列表和折叠的工具行。AgentAstra 想走另一条路：保留完整对话，同时把工作铺展成一个可以穿行的小空间。回复、命令、文件修改和子任务不再只是文"},{"id":"p37s2","text":"本流中的一行——它们都有位置、关系和发生的时刻。"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"## 一眼能看到什么"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"- **语义时间（Z）** — 按有意义的事件而非每个流式 token 穿行。过去渐隐、现在被标出，未来只保留结构，不提前泄露内容。
[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
